In detail

Gallaratese and San Leonardo are largely residential (Gallaratese known for modernist architecture, including the 'Monte Amiata' complex), with older reporting of burglaries that once prompted resident patrols, but nothing alarming for a visitor passing through. The real, well-documented concern is the Lampugnano hub (metro terminus plus the intercity coach station): multiple 2023-2026 reports describe recurring theft, aggressive unlicensed touts, drug dealing, and a nighttime assault, with the city repeatedly increasing patrols. Daytime with police presence is calmer; avoid loitering around the bus terminal after dark.
